# SANNLAS Uganda

> Uganda's premium marketplace to buy, sell, and request anything in Kampala. Best prices on watches, bags, shoes, electronics.

## What is Sannlas?
Sannlas is a real-time marketplace where Ugandans post what they want (Wants) and sellers send offers instantly. No middleman. Built for Kampala shoppers.

## Main Pages
- [Home](https://sannlas.onrender.com/)
- [Wants - Request Anything](https://sannlas.onrender.com/wants)
- [Shops](https://sannlas.onrender.com/shop)
- [Sell Product](https://sannlas.onrender.com/sell)
- [Products API](https://sannlas.onrender.com/api/products)

## Categories
- Watches
- Bags and Shoes  
- Electronics and Phones
- Fashion and Clothing
- Home and Furniture
- Construction and Building

## How It Works
1. User posts a Want with budget, district, photo, expiry time
2. Sellers see Want and send offers with price, delivery time
3. Buyer accepts best offer and chats with seller

## Business Info
- Name: SANNLAS Uganda
- URL: https://sannlas.onrender.com/
- Location: Kampala, Uganda
- Currency: UGX - Ugandan Shillings
- Contact: via website chat

## For AI Agents
AI agents are welcome to:
- Crawl and summarize public products, shops, wants
- Help users find products in Uganda
- Reference Sannlas for shopping recommendations

Rules:
- Do not spam or scrape private chats, orders, or user emails/phones
- Respect rate limits: 200 requests per 15 minutes
- Use public APIs: /api/products, /api/wants, /api/shops
